Q1.rationale: No provision requires the Receiving Party to notify the Disclosing Party of a legally required disclosure; clause 10 only refers to statutory confidentiality.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: The NDA contains no duty to promptly notify the Disclosing Party of unauthorized use or disclosure.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Clause 3 bars disclosure to third parties without approval, but clause 22 treats consultants acting within the scope of their engagement as permitted representatives, and clause 4 allows disclosure to service providers and auditors.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Clause 22 makes the Receiving Party responsible for breaches by its employees acting within the scope of their employment, which contemplates employee access.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: The NDA sets no return or destruction obligation on termination; clause 6 and clause 9 only state duration and survival.
Q5.label: NotMentioned

Q6.rationale: The NDA contains no restriction on reporting violations of law to government agencies or regulators.
Q6.label: NotMentioned

Q7.rationale: Segment 27 expressly permits the Receiving Party to develop similar products or services, whether or not it uses ideas learned from the Disclosing Party.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Clause 11 states that no implied or express license is created from either Party.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Clause 3 requires at least the same care as for own information and no less than a reasonable degree of care, though it does not list the specific safeguard types.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Clause 9 states that the Receiving Party's obligations survive termination of the Agreement or return of the Confidential Information.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no confidentiality term about the fact that the agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 29 provides for a US$500,000 penalty payable on any breach, irrespective of actual loss suffered.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Clause 2 covers information in whatever form, which includes verbally conveyed information.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Clause 3 provides that Confidential Information shall be used only for the purposes of facilitating the business relationship.
Q14.label: Entailment
